title: Antique Pewter Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Valet Stand 5X14X5, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Antique Pewter, paper towel holder for kitchen countertops, 14 inches tall (14-inch, 14in) with a 5 in x 5 in base footprint (5x14x5), which offers a soft, silvery-gray tone with subtle warmth, bridging traditional and contemporary aesthetics. This freestanding paper towel stand / paper towel valet requires no wall mounting and keeps paper towels within reach on the counter. Solid brass construction with a weighted base helps prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces. Contemporary, modern crisp design for clean-lined kitchens. Available in multiple lifetime designer finishes; designer finish provides corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Includes: paper towel holder. Product weight: 4.8 lb. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
